name: Eliashib
bio: Eliashib the high priest led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall, rising up with his fellow priests to build and consecrate the Sheep Gate, the first section named in Nehemiah's detailed roster of builders (Nehemiah 3:1). His family's later entanglement with Nehemiah's chief opponent Tobiah is told in the chapters ahead. While Nehemiah was away in Babylon, Eliashib, as the priest in charge of the temple storerooms, allied himself with Tobiah and gave him a large chamber once used for offerings and Levite portions. When Nehemiah returned and learned of it, he threw out all of Tobiah's belongings and had the room purified and restored to its proper use (Nehemiah 13:4-9). Later, one of the sons of his grandson Joiada married Sanballat's daughter, and Nehemiah drove him away for defiling the priesthood (Nehemiah 13:28-29).
